en.summary: Clearer Examination Sets reports, progress across sets, accurate paper previews and protected deletion.
items: A tidier workspace and cleaner Class Analysis and Streams & Groups reports, with clear Scored, ABS and Blank counts.
Cumulative Progress: a clear chart of each pupil’s progress across sets and printable class and pupil reports, with ranks explained.
Paper preview shows true A4 width; print and PDF layouts are more consistent.

Permanently delete an Examination Set or Preparation Group only after a warning, a reason and the exact name typed. A receipt without pupil names stays in Deletion History; backups and PDFs already made keep copies.
Pupils with only draft marks or absence can be deleted; pupils in confirmed (or formerly confirmed) results stay protected.
Known limit: in Microsoft Edge, printing Progress may add an extra blank page. Your records are not affected.
No change to your marks, grades, ranks or backups.

sw.summary: Ripoti wazi zaidi za Seti za Mitihani, maendeleo kati ya seti, mwonekano sahihi wa karatasi na ufutaji uliolindwa.
items: Eneo la Seti za Mitihani lililopangika, na ripoti safi zaidi za Uchambuzi wa Darasa na Mikondo na Makundi zenye hesabu wazi za Wenye alama, ABS na Tupu.
Maendeleo Limbikizi: chati wazi ya maendeleo ya kila mwanafunzi kati ya seti na ripoti za darasa na mwanafunzi zinazochapishwa, nafasi zikielezwa.
Mwonekano wa karatasi unaonyesha upana halisi wa A4; kuchapisha na PDF kunalingana zaidi.

Futa kabisa Seti ya Mtihani au Kundi la Maandalizi tu baada ya onyo, sababu na jina kamili. Risiti isiyo na majina ya wanafunzi hubaki kwenye Historia ya Ufutaji; nakala za hifadhi na PDF zilizokwisha tengenezwa zinabaki.
Mwanafunzi mwenye alama za rasimu au kutokuwepo tu anaweza kufutwa; wanaohusika na matokeo yaliyothibitishwa (au yaliyowahi kuthibitishwa) wanalindwa.
Kikomo kinachojulikana: kwenye Microsoft Edge, kuchapisha Maendeleo kunaweza kuongeza ukurasa tupu wa ziada. Rekodi zako haziathiriki.
Hakuna mabadiliko kwenye alama, daraja, nafasi wala nakala zako za hifadhi.
